categories.regle: avais/étais + participe => had + participe passé (3e colonne).
On compte depuis la dernière fois : It had been X since he had LAST done (pas de not).

categories.nom: Imparfait : habitude ou action en cours
categories.regle: Peut-on dire « était en train de » ? Oui => was + -ing. Non (habitude) => prétérit, used to, would.
Ordre affirmatif, pas de did, et recul des temps : where I had found.
Après did, does, will, would, can : 1re colonne (base verbale).
have/has/had juste avant => 3e colonne (rung, hidden, known). Verbe seul au passé => 2e colonne (rang, hid, knew).
depuis + présent => have lived since/for ; résultat visible au moment où l'on parle => You've grown.

categories.nom: Repères dans un récit au passé
categories.regle: this => that, here => there, today => that day.
Après le premier auxiliaire : would probably never have come.
Vérifier les faux amis et le mot naturel en contexte.

erreurs.francais: Cela faisait deux mois qu'il n'avait pas parlé à son frère.
erreurs.faux: It had been two months since he hadn't talked to his brother.
erreurs.correct: It had been two months since he had last talked to his brother.

erreurs.francais: Il me demanda où j'avais trouvé cette lettre.
erreurs.faux: He asked me where I found this mail.
erreurs.correct: He asked me where I had found that letter.

erreurs.francais: une lettre
erreurs.faux: a mail
erreurs.correct: a letter (mail = le courrier, un e-mail)

erreurs.francais: cette lettre (récit au passé)
erreurs.faux: this letter
erreurs.correct: that letter

erreurs.francais: comme s'ils ne s'étaient jamais rencontrés
erreurs.faux: like they'd never met
erreurs.correct: as if they had never met

erreurs.francais: Chaque dimanche, mon grand-père allait au marché.
erreurs.faux: Every Sunday, my grandpa was going to the market.
erreurs.correct: Every Sunday, my grandfather went / used to go to the market.

erreurs.francais: Il n'a pas compris pourquoi elle pleurait.
erreurs.faux: He didn't understand why she cried.
erreurs.correct: He didn't understand why she was crying.

erreurs.francais: J'habite ici depuis 2019.
erreurs.faux: I live here since 2019.
erreurs.correct: I have lived here since 2019.

erreurs.francais: Je voulais savoir combien de temps il était resté.
erreurs.faux: I wanted to know how long did he stayed for.
erreurs.correct: I wanted to know how long he had stayed.

erreurs.francais: Il savait que sa sœur avait menti.
erreurs.faux: He knew that his sister lied.
erreurs.correct: He knew that his sister had lied.

erreurs.francais: Le samedi, mon père se levait toujours tôt.
erreurs.faux: On Saturday, my dad used to wake up earlier.
erreurs.correct: On Saturdays, my father always got up early.

erreurs.francais: Je ne savais pas où il avait caché les clés.
erreurs.faux: I did'nt know where he had hid the keys.
erreurs.correct: I didn't know where he had hidden the keys.

erreurs.francais: comme s'ils s'étaient toujours connus
erreurs.faux: as if they had always knew each other
erreurs.correct: as if they had always known each other

erreurs.francais: Cela faisait trois ans que Thomas n'avait pas mis les pieds dans la librairie de son oncle.
erreurs.faux: It had been three years since Thomas hadn't stepped in his uncle's library.
erreurs.correct: It had been three years since Thomas had last set foot in his uncle's bookshop.

erreurs.francais: une librairie
erreurs.faux: a library
erreurs.correct: a bookshop (library = bibliothèque)

erreurs.francais: la cloche sonnait toujours
erreurs.faux: the bell always rung
erreurs.correct: the bell still rang

erreurs.francais: quand on ouvrait la porte
erreurs.faux: when someone was opening the door
erreurs.correct: whenever someone opened the door

erreurs.francais: « Tu as grandi », finit-il par dire.
erreurs.faux: "You grew up", he finally says.
erreurs.correct: "You've grown," he said at last.

erreurs.francais: Il ne savait pas pourquoi il était revenu
erreurs.faux: Neither he knew why he came back
erreurs.correct: He didn't know why he had come back

erreurs.francais: ce qu'il avait espéré trouver (là)
erreurs.faux: what he had hopped to find here
erreurs.correct: what he had hoped to find there

erreurs.francais: Si sa mère ne lui avait pas parlé de...
erreurs.faux: If his mother hadn't talk to him about...
erreurs.correct: If his mother hadn't told him about...

erreurs.francais: il ne serait sans doute jamais venu
erreurs.faux: he would have probably never come
erreurs.correct: he would probably never have come
